objective: At n = 2^m, h = n/2, q = 2n, for a in GF(q)* with G the monic least-degree element of ker X_b (b = sqrt(a)), k = h - deg G, J = ceil(k/2) and u = (w - a)/a: prove (1) the sparse Taylor form Omega(a + d) = (1 + d/a)(Omega_a + sum over r = 1..m-1 of d^(2^r) k^(h - 2^(r-1))) mod d^n; (2) the Hankel reduction: near a, Z(w) is equivalent to diag(H(w), I) with H(w) the (h/2) x (h/2) Hankel matrix of psi_1(w), ..., psi_(h-1)(w), psi(w) = (Omega(w) + k + 1)/(k Omega(w) + (k + 1)^2) mod k^h written in Y; (3) Gamma^(k) = [k - i - j is a power of two]_(i, j < J) is invertible over GF(2) for every k; and, as the target, (4) the leading form: the symmetric reduction M of Z to ker X_b = G F[Y]_(<J) (complement: the monomials off the kernel's top degrees) has M_ij = u^(2k - 1 - 2(i + j)) (Gamma^(k)_ij + O(u)), so that with (3) G Y^j heads a Jordan chain of exactly 2k - 1 - 4j and these are the partial multiplicities; or the order where the argument stops. Found by exact computation before registration: (1) at sides 8 to 32, the partial multiplicities of H at sides 8 to 32, (3) for k < 400, (4) at every a for sides 8 to 64.
status: Proved 2026-11-10 (by hand, with finite checks; pre-registered in c252175e4): at sides 2^m the family carrying the cone's spectrum is, near each eigenvalue parameter a, S + (w/a)(b + k^h L(w^2/k)) with L(x) = x + x^2 + x^4 + ...; it is equivalent to one Hankel (moment) matrix of psi(w) = (Omega + k + 1)/(k Omega + (k + 1)^2) in Y; the leading matrix [k - i - j a power of two] is invertible over GF(2) for every k; and the reduction to the eigenvectors G Y^j vanishes to order 3 below the corner anti-diagonals with coefficient [Y^(h - 2 - i - j)] N(G) at order 3, so every eigenvalue has exactly k mod 2 Jordan blocks of size 1, none of size 2 and one of size 3 exactly when k is even (the chain lemma in full for k <= 2). Computed exactly: the reduction's leading part is the Hankel matrix of u^-1 Y^k L(u^2/Y) (entries start at u^(2k-1-2(i+j)) with coefficient [k - i - j a power of two]) at every eigenvalue for sides 8 to 256 (128 after registration, 256 in the stress run), which with the invertible leading matrix is the whole chain lemma. The leading form from order 4 on is not proved.
title: The reduced form at every order
